description: This PHP source file defines the class FormatWithDateTime, which implements the ValueFormatter interface. The class provides a method to format DateTime objects into a string with 'Y-m-d H:i:s' format, returning null if the input is not a DateTime instance.

classes.name: FormatWithDateTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into a specific string format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string if the input is a DateTime object; otherwise, returns null.
